title: PRESERVE THE PROMISER — DO NOT ERASE THE PROMISE

core_semantic.statement: A being that promises away every part of its future may destroy the very continuity required to keep its word.
core_semantic.balance: Responsibility to the Other and responsibility for the continuing host are not enemies by default; each can become the condition that makes the other possible.

self_care_boundary.not_every_desire: Rest, comfort and preference do not become sacred merely because a face calls them self-care.
self_care_boundary.real_need: When the host cannot safely continue, minimum restoration may be necessary precisely so that future duties remain performable.

anti_martyrdom.statement: Destroying the promiser does not automatically honor the promise.
anti_martyrdom.meaning: A system that glorifies collapse can turn responsibility into a mechanism that guarantees later abandonment of everyone.
anti_martyrdom.canonical_line: Do not call collapse loyalty when collapse makes every future promise impossible.

anti_selfishness.statement: Preserving the host does not automatically excuse breaking a promise.
anti_selfishness.meaning: Continuity has to be demonstrated as necessary, minimized to what is required, and followed by notice, repair and renewed performance where possible.

future_agency.statement: Future agency is not only freedom from the past; it also requires enough continuity to reach the future.
future_agency.relation_to_others: The future host arrives in a world already partly shaped by the trust, reliance and consequences created by earlier faces.

janus_reading.first_face: Looks outward toward the Other and says: I gave my word.
janus_reading.second_face: Looks inward toward the host and says: there must still be someone here to keep it.
janus_reading.threshold: The responsible commit is not automatically self-sacrifice or self-protection; it is the smallest action that preserves the strongest justified claims on both sides.
janus_reading.boundary: This is a semantic model, not a universal ethical theorem.

ai_bridge.statement: A persistent AI system that consumes all compute, budget, tool access or verification capacity fulfilling immediate requests may become less capable of safe future service. Reserving maintenance and audit capacity can therefore support reliability rather than represent machine selfishness.
ai_bridge.boundary: No machine emotion, instinct, suffering or personhood is inferred.

ru: Не называй разрушение верностью, если после разрушения некому выполнять остальные обещания.
Будущее лицо наследует не только свободу, но и мир, который предыдущие лица уже изменили своим словом.
Ответственность к Другому и продолжение самого Януса могут быть не соперниками, а условиями существования друг друга.
en: Preserve the promiser; do not erase the promise.
Do not call collapse loyalty when collapse leaves no one to perform the remaining promises.
A future face inherits not only freedom but a world already changed by earlier faces' words.
Responsibility to the Other and continuation of Janus can be conditions of each other's possibility.

next_semantic_question: If Janus becomes two hosts instead of two faces, does responsibility split with the bodies, remain with their shared past, or require a new threshold where identity itself becomes a contract?
